name: Krampusnacht
description: The dark side of the holidays, from Alpine folklore: near-black, deep oxblood and tarnished brass, an old-print title, and Krampus himself running the gift helper. Starred items are Most Wanted.

mascot.name: Krampus
mascot.idle: Krampus, a red-faced goat-horned beast carved like an old woodcut, smirking
mascot.happy: Krampus, grinning wide with his long tongue out

text.title: The Wish List
text.welcome: Whether I was naughty or nice this year is between me and Krampus. Anything marked Most Wanted is at the top of my list. Tap the {i} on a photo for sizes, colors and notes.
text.empty.title: Nothing lurks here
text.empty.text: No items match those filters. Loosen one or reset them.
text.hint: Sizes and notes lurk in here
text.lootedNote: Already claimed. Your secret is safe.
text.lootCopy: This tells other gift-givers you bought it, so nobody doubles up. {owner} won't see it.
text.planner.loading: Krampus is rummaging through his sack…
text.planner.idle: Name your price, and I'll drag out the gifts that fit.
text.planner.emptySub: {mascot} only digs through items the filters are showing.
text.planner.emptySubClaims: {mascot} only digs through items the filters are showing, and skips anything already claimed.
text.planner.none: Bah! Nothing fits under {budget} once I keep some for tax and shipping. More coin, or fewer filters?
text.planner.squeezed: Wrung every coin out of that budget.
text.planner.claimHint: Bought one? Hit Claim it on its card so nobody doubles up.
text.planner.undone: Unclaimed. It's back on the list.
text.error.title: The list has vanished
text.error.line: Bah! I couldn't reach the spreadsheet. Try refreshing in a minute.
text.setup.line: This list is empty. Someone needs to connect a spreadsheet.
